App release

v2.0.4 is live.

The Electron app, terminal client, and npm launcher ship together. This release adds a tokenizer-backed context panel, a “Where you left off” session digest, Fast reply speeds, and a System colour theme. Response length now changes both the prompt and the reply budget; v1.5 remains the published model and v1.6 remains a preview.

The launcher needs Node.js 18+, Python 3.10+, and a model checkpoint. It downloads the app; it does not bundle Python or weights.

Changelog

What changed in 2.0.4.

Real context accounting, a useful long-chat digest, Fast reply speeds, effective response length, and a modernized evaluation framework.

AreaChange
Context panelAdded The status-bar panel counts the base prompt, mode instructions, response-length clause, project rules, and conversation with the real tokenizer. It no longer estimates tokens by dividing characters by four.
Where you left offAdded Long chats open with a local digest of where the conversation started, the last question, and the last reply. It makes no model call, caches nothing, hides during streaming, and can be dismissed per session.
Fast reply speedsAdded Fast, Turbo, and Ultrafast sit under Fast mode with their own prompt clause, colour, and reply budget. The slider supports dragging as well as clicks and arrow keys.
System themeAdded The desktop and web settings can follow the operating system's light or dark preference and update live when it changes.
Response lengthChanged Short and Detailed now add explicit prompt instructions and apply their 0.6× and 1.5× budget multipliers; Normal stays silent at 1.0×. The composer's + → Reply menu and Settings → Chat stay in sync, and a saved choice applies at startup.
EvaluationChanged Benchmark cases are versioned, custom scorers can be registered, weights affect the score, manual cases fail loudly, and timestamps are timezone-aware. The app's scorecard shape is unchanged.
FixesBoth clients The context panel refreshes after mode, effort, speed, or length changes; response-length budgets and saved values now work; the Fast slider no longer throws on synthetic pointer events; and a fresh checkout includes the benchmark cases and suite runner.

Known limits

What is not ready.

These are the boundaries behind the preview label. They are not release notes for a finished version.

  • ×v1.6 weights are pending.The preview checkpoint is for evaluation; v1.5 is the model you can run.
  • ×Downstream benchmarks are not published.Only held-out BPB and validation loss are available.
  • ×2,048-token context.The app does not extend the model's window.
  • ×No vision path.There is no image encoder, image tokens, or multimodal projection.

Release policy

Gates, not a date.

The stable 1.6 release ships after six measured gates pass, not on a calendar date. The repository release policy is the source of truth.
